description: Is this Solana wallet a bundler? Every pump.fun launch it bought in the first 2 slots over the last 10 days, which creators it keeps bundling for, and whether it is a mass sniper bot or a dev's private bundle wallet. From our block-0 registry of every pump.fun launch (non-creator buys in slots 0–1 after creation). kind: "sniper bot" (≥50 launches in 7 days, buys everything), "dev wallet" (most of its block-0 buys are on one or two creators' coins — a private bundle wallet), "bundler", or "not seen". Use it on wallets bundle_forensics lists, or on any wallet you are about to copy. When to use: To check one wallet from bundle_forensics (sniper bot vs a dev's private bundle wallet); for trading performance use pump_wallet (on the MAD Synapse · Pump & LP server, https://agent.maddegen.art/hub/mcp/pump). Price: $0.002 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).
